description: This file defines an Android Activity that displays a grid of app icons loaded from the device's launcher activities, utilizing animation and layout features.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation5
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a grid of app icons with layout animation.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseAdapter to supply app icon views for the GridView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overridden method to initialize activity, load apps, and set content view with grid.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Loads a list of launcher activities available on the device.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates and returns a view (ImageView) for each item in the grid.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items to display, capped at 32.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves the app info at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as item ID.
